shellCommands.command: ls /workspace && echo "---" && cat /workspace/package.json && echo "--- DOCS ---" && ls /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/ 2>/dev/null
ls /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/ && echo "=== FONT API REF ===" && find /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app -iname "*font*"
cat /workspace/app/layout.tsx && echo "--- PAGE ---" && cat /workspace/app/page.tsx && echo "--- EVAL ---" && ls -R /workspace/__agent_eval__ 2>/dev/null | head -30

ls /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/upgrading/ && echo "=== grep font in v16 ===" && grep -rn -i "font" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/upgrading/version-16.md 2>/dev/null
ls .next/static/media/ 2>/dev/null | head && echo "=== font-face families in built CSS ===" && grep -rho "font-family:[^;}]*" .next/static/css/*.css 2>/dev/null | sort -u
find .next -name "*.css" | head -10 && echo "=== families ===" && find .next -name "*.css" -exec grep -ho "font-family: *[^;}]*" {} \; 2>/dev/null | sort -u

grep -o "\.playfair_display[^{]*{[^}]*}" .next/static/chunks/*.css | head -3; echo "---"; grep -o "\.roboto[^{]*{[^}]*}" .next/static/chunks/*.css | head -3; echo "=== preloads ==="; grep -o '<link rel="preload"[^>]*font[^>]*>' .next/server/app/index.html | head
